blockers.fix: Day fifty-five. More money than the whole planet makes in a year (c09).

blockers.quote: And if you never stop? Day two hundred and sixty-seven. More cents in your account than atoms in the observable universe (c12).
blockers.why: Overstates the certainty of claim c12. The verbatim quote states the Eddington number is 'approximately 10^80 hydrogen atoms'. Because day 267 (2^266 cents ≈ 1.19 × 10^80) is an order-of-magnitude comparison against an estimate, stating an absolute count ('than atoms') rather than an estimate exceeds what the source quote supports.
blockers.fix: And if you never stop? Day two hundred and sixty-seven. More cents in your account than estimated atoms in the observable universe (c12).
